securityValueShareNote: securityValueShare is the fraction of a SKU's price this tool attributes to its security-bearing capabilities. It is this tool's allocation model, not a Microsoft-published figure, and the report says so. It exists because no vendor publishes 'the Safe Links portion of an E5 seat'. Override per SKU as needed.

prices.$note: Microsoft 365 E7. Launched 1 May 2026 at a USD 99 list price per user per month on an annual term. E7 bundles E5, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Agent 365 and the Entra Suite. securityValueShare is derived rather than published: E5 contributes 0.4 of USD 57, which is USD 22.80, and the Entra Suite adds roughly USD 12 of identity and network security, so about USD 35 of the USD 99 is security-bearing. Copilot and Agent 365 are not. That is this tool's allocation model and a consultant should override it when the customer disagrees.
prices.$source: Widely reported at USD 99 list (Directions on Microsoft, SAMexpert, Valorem Reply). Not confirmed against a Microsoft-published price page.
